install_steps: npm install -g dembrandt  — global install via npm
Or use via npx: npx dembrandt <url>  — no install needed, runs on demand
sc dembrandt analyze <url>  — extract design tokens from any website
sc dembrandt analyze <url> --save-output  — save as JSON for documentation
sc dembrandt analyze <url> --dtcg  — export in W3C Design Tokens standard format
sc dembrandt analyze <url> --browser=firefox  — use Firefox for bot-protected sites
note: Requires Node.js 18+ and npm. Dembrandt uses Playwright under the hood which downloads Chromium (and optionally Firefox) browser engines on first run (~150MB). First extraction may take longer due to browser download. The --browser=firefox flag helps on websites with aggressive bot detection. The --slow flag helps with JavaScript-heavy single-page applications.
